metadata.final_500_pool_note: Batch 06 FINAL completes SK Primary Y1 Science 500/500. B01-B05 + B06 = 50+100+100+100+100+50 = 500 questions. B06 brings distribution to canonical: 100/60/80/50/60/50/100 (Haiwan/Tumbuhan/Bahan/Pergerakan/Panas/Cuaca/Pemerhatian), 60/30/10 (E/M/H), 46/26/28 (REC/COMP/APP).
metadata.originality_audit: All 50 questions ORIGINAL / self_authored. Reference DB used ONLY as KSSR Y1 Science style anchor. No copy, near-paraphrase, synonym replacement, or numerical-only swap from any source. Cross-batch uniqueness verified vs B01 (50), B02 (100), B03 (100), B04 (100), B05 (100), and 50 newly generated questions in this batch.
